description: For Boolean algebra elements a and b, a is at most b exactly when the Stone image of a is contained in that of b.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.stoneMap_order.{u} {B : Type u} [BooleanAlgebra B] (a b : B) :
  a ≤ b ↔ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.stoneMap a ⊆ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.stoneMap b
